Wordle

How To Play

Find groups of four words that share something in common.

  • Tap four words, then hit Submit.
  • Each wrong guess costs one of your 4 mistakes. You'll see "One away..." when 3 of your 4 words belong together.
  • Each group has a color. Yellow is the easiest, then green, blue, and purple is the trickiest.
  • Watch out for words that could fit in more than one group.

Unlocked Mode (beta): turn it on in settings. One word in each group is locked. Tap it to play a mini-game (Wordle, Anagram, Word Search or Crossword) and open it.

There's no daily limit. Hit Next Puzzle when you finish for a new one.

How To Play

Fill the grid so every row, column and 3x3 box has the numbers 1 to 9 once.

  • Tap a square, then tap a number. You can also use your keyboard.
  • A wrong number turns red and adds a mistake. Erase it and try again.
  • Turn on Notes to jot small pencil marks instead of a number.
  • Stuck? Hint fills in one square for you.

Keys: 1-9 place a number, arrows move, Backspace erases, N toggles notes, U undoes, H gives a hint.

How To Play

Fill the little crossword using the clues. Words run across and down.

  • Tap a square to pick it. Tap it again to switch between across and down.
  • Type with the keyboard below or your own keyboard.
  • Check marks any wrong letters in red. Reveal fills in the whole word you're on.
  • The timer starts right away, so go fast!

Keys: arrows move, Space or Tab switches clues, Backspace erases.

How To Play

Make words from the six letters. Find the word that uses all of them to win.

  • Tap letters or type to build a word. Words need 4 or more letters.
  • Press Enter to try it. Each letter can be used once.
  • The bar fills as you find the common words. Rare words still count as a bonus.
  • Hint shows the start of a word you haven't found.

Keys: letters type, Enter tries the word, Backspace deletes, Space shuffles.

How To Play

Make words from the seven letters. Every word must use the gold letter.

  • Words need 4 or more letters. Letters can be used again.
  • 4 letters = 1 point. Longer words = 1 point per letter.
  • A pangram uses all seven letters and gives 7 bonus points.
  • Reach Genius to beat the level. Your time to get there is your score.

Keys: letters type, Enter tries the word, Backspace deletes, Space shuffles.

Fill the rows with words that make these colors

How To Play

Wordle backwards. The answer is at the bottom. Fill each row with a real word that gives the colors shown, if that word was a guess for the answer.

  • Green: the letter is in the answer, in that spot.
  • Yellow: the letter is in the answer, in a different spot.
  • Gray: the letter is not in the answer.
  • Tap a row to pick it. Wrong colors flash red.
  • Your time is your score. A hint adds 30 seconds.

How To Play

Guess the hidden word one letter at a time.

  • Pick a letter. If it's in the word, it shows up. If not, the drawing gets one more part.
  • Six wrong guesses and the game is over.
  • Your time is your score. A hint reveals a letter and adds 30 seconds.
  • Words get longer as the levels go up.

You can type letters on a keyboard too.

How To Play

Name as many countries as you can. Each one is worth a point.

  • Type a country and it turns green on the map. No need to press enter when the name is complete.
  • Small slips in spelling still count. Press enter after a long name to check it.
  • Drag to move the map and pinch or scroll to zoom. Tiny countries show up as dots.
  • 5 minutes: name the most you can before time runs out.
  • Timed: name every country on the map as fast as you can.

When it's over, tap a country to see its name.

How To Play

Find every word from the list hidden in the grid.

  • Press on the first letter and drag across the word. Let go to check it.
  • Words run in straight lines. Early levels go across and down, and later ones go diagonal and backwards too.
  • Your time is your score. A hint flashes the first letter of a word and adds 30 seconds.
  • Grids get bigger and the lists get longer as the levels go up.

How To Play

A flag appears. Type the country it belongs to.

  • Right answers jump straight to the next flag. No need to press enter when the name is complete.
  • Small slips in spelling still count. Press enter to check a long name.
  • Stuck? Skip it. Skipped flags come back later.
  • 5 minutes: name as many flags as you can.
  • Timed: name every flag as fast as you can.

Editor

Connect to GitHub

Paste a token so this page can save puzzles to your repo. It stays in this browser only.

How do I make a token?
  1. On GitHub, go to Settings, then Developer settings, then Personal access tokens, then Fine-grained tokens.
  2. Tap Generate new token and give it any name.
  3. Under Repository access, pick Only select repositories and choose this repo.
  4. Under Permissions, set Contents to Read and write.
  5. Generate it, copy it, and paste it above.

How To Play

Guess the hidden word in 6 tries.

  • Every guess has to be a real word of the right length.
  • After each guess, the tiles change color to show how close you were.
  • Stuck? Hint shows one letter in its right spot, up to 2 times a round.

Examples

S
T
O
R
M

S is in the word and in the right spot.

B
R
A
V
E

R is in the word but in the wrong spot.

M
O
U
S
E

U is not in the word at all.

There's no daily limit. When a round ends, hit Play Again for a new random word. You can pick 4 to 7 letter words in Settings.
